notes.title: Testing, 1 2....
notes.content:
hell... Hello? Is anyone still here? Does anyone even play the g... nevermind. 

Our previous post stated that we would being working on new projects and games, just not to the same level... well, we have some news, folks!

We're making a new game. 

Oh goodness - what's that sound? Why is the ground shaking?! Is that... an earthquake?

Nope. It's the combined sound of the steam community crying, shouting and already writing out a email to valve saying how bad we are. 

However you may rejoice, dear steam users, as this game isn't in our usual vein,  as isn't a "comedy" game. It's an addictive puzzle game.

Please don't go blocking us from steam, valve.  

We'll be good, honest!

~ Dawooskhe Games

notes.title: Hello and Goodbye
notes.content:
Hello everybody, haters, 'fans' and those 6 people who refunded the game, my dudes, the game might not be the best game out there, but it's under $3, why do need that $1.99 so badly? [b] I'm not salty ːsteamsaltyː  [/b]

Anywho, we've shutting up shop, for now at least. 

We WERE working on a new game, and funding just simply ran out, unless you count steam wallet money, but we can't exactly pay for talent in that, 
[i] can we? [/i]

And no, we're not E-Begging for cash, we're just simply stating the facts.

Now this isn't to say we won't make more games, and I can hear all of steam collectively sigh and tut as I write that, but it's true, they'll just be different. 

Now, we're not and YOUR certainly not saying 'A Shawn Story' was of a high standard, we agree, it wasn't ready for steam, however the games we make in the future will be of a different standard, not specify worse, not specify better, just different.

Also, happy new year folks, I'm currently writing this at almost 4 in the morning, so sorry in advance for anything that doesn't make sense, including but exclusive to:

- This post
- The Nude Noob Ending
- Why in back to the future, after the movie's events unfold, does the Father of marty, not question why his son looks exactly like the guy who set him and his wife up? Surely he suspects some sort of foul playing going on, like cheating or a one night stand? That's a huge plothole,  like what the actual 
f
inally, I'd like to thank everyone who even looked at the game storefront, not as much as the people who bought it, but still thanks!

- Alex

notes.title: CH-CH-CHANGES!
notes.content:
You may have noticed a few details being added on the storefront - good eye! 

We're busy fixing up the store front (and game!) to the best of our ability to give a great first impression - is it working? ːsteammockingː

We hope you enjoy the game when it finally comes out - and no! It isn't us who's pausing release - we have to wait 2 weeks for game to come out - we're as frustrated yet excited as you are!

That's why we're constantly updating little things (and big things - behind the scenes) around and about the game - if there's a problem - we'll trynna fix it as soon as possible!

Thanks!
Alex 

P.S - SHAAAAAAAAAAAAWNNNN!
